title: Bank of America revamps AMD stock price target for 2026

content_html:
For years, the AI chip conversation has had one dominant name and a long list of challengers trying to close the gap. Most of them haven't.

One of them is starting to look different, and Bank of America just made that case in writing.

Bank of America analyst Vivek Arya, who covers semiconductors for the firm, spent July 23 in San Francisco watching AMD make its most ambitious AI pitch to date. By the following morning, he had a new price objective and a significantly expanded view of how large AMD's AI market opportunity could become.

The bank raised its price objective on AMD to $620 from $560, reiterating a buy rating, with AMD shares trading at $554.23 on July 24. But the more significant part of the note isn't the number. It's how the bank is now describing AMD's place in the AI market.

How Bank of America is reframing AMD's AI market position

The language Bank of America used in the note is worth paying attention to. The bank said AMD has "successfully transitioned from a merchant GPU vendor to a full-stack, rack-scale accelerator systems supplier."

That's a meaningful distinction. AMD is no longer being compared only to Nvidia on chip-by-chip specifications. It's being evaluated as a systems-level competitor with an integrated hardware and software offering.

More Bank of America:

  • Bank of America warns America now has 2 economies

  • Bank of America answers a tough stock market question

  • Bank of America gives stock market investors a summer reality check

Analyst Vivek Arya set the $620 price objective at 47 times the bank's 2027 estimated non-GAAP earnings per share, toward the middle to upper range of AMD's historical 13x-to-58x multiple. He said that multiple is supported by AMD's potential for 50% or higher annual EPS growth and its share gains in AI CPUs and GPUs.

AMD also updated its total addressable market forecasts at the event. The company now targets a total compute market of more than $2 trillion by 2030, up from a prior estimate of $1 trillion.

Its AI accelerator TAM estimate rose to $1.4 trillion from $500 billion, and its server CPU TAM target increased to $220 billion from $120 billion earlier this year, Investing.com reported.

Why AMD's Helios rack is central to the Bank of America thesis

The product at the center of the upgraded thesis is AMD's Helios rack, which the bank said is now in full production with deployments beginning in the third quarter and ramping into the fourth. Each rack integrates 72 MI455X GPUs with 18 EPYC Venice CPUs, Pensando networking chips, and ROCm software support. AMD's shift into full rack-scale AI systems has been building all year, as TheStreet reported.

content_html_zh:
多年来，人工智能芯片领域一直有一个主导名字，以及一长串试图缩小差距的挑战者。 他们中的大多数人都没有。

其中之一开始看起来有所不同，美国银行刚刚以书面形式阐述了这一点。

美国银行分析师 Vivek Arya（负责该公司半导体业务）7 月 23 日在旧金山观看 AMD 迄今为止最雄心勃勃的人工智能宣传活动。 第二天早上，他有了新的价格目标，并对 AMD 的人工智能市场机会有多大有了更广泛的认识。

该银行将 AMD 的目标股价从 560 美元上调至 620 美元，重申买入评级，7 月 24 日 AMD 股价为 554.23 美元。 但笔记中更重要的部分不是数字。 这就是该银行现在描述 AMD 在人工智能市场中的地位的方式。

美国银行如何重塑 AMD 的人工智能市场地位

美国银行在票据中使用的语言值得关注。 该银行表示，AMD“已成功从商用 GPU 供应商转型为全栈、机架级加速器系统供应商”。

这是一个有意义的区别。 AMD 不再仅在芯片规格上与 Nvidia 进行比较。 它被评估为具有集成硬件和软件产品的系统级竞争对手。

更多美国银行：

  • 美国银行警告美国现在有两个经济体
  • 美国银行回答棘手的股市问题
  • 美国银行为股市投资者提供夏季现实检查

分析师 Vivek Arya 将 620 美元的价格目标设定为该银行 2027 年非 GAAP 预期每股收益的 47 倍，接近 AMD 历史 13 倍至 58 倍市盈率的中上范围。 他表示，AMD 每股收益年增长 50% 或更高的潜力以及其在 AI CPU 和 GPU 领域的份额增长为这一市盈率提供了支撑。

AMD 还在此次活动中更新了其总体目标市场预测。 该公司目前的目标是到 2030 年计算市场总额超过 2 万亿美元，高于之前估计的 1 万亿美元。

据 Investing.com 报道，其 AI 加速器 TAM 目标从今年早些时候的 5000 亿美元增至 1.4 万亿美元，服务器 CPU TAM 目标从今年早些时候的 1200 亿美元增至 2200 亿美元。

为什么 AMD 的 Helios 机架是美国银行论文的核心

升级论文的核心产品是AMD的Helios机架，该银行表示该产品现已全面投入生产，部署将从第三季度开始，并逐步进入第四季度。 每个机架集成了 72 个 MI455X GPU 和 18 个 EPYC Venice CPU、Pensando 网络芯片和 ROCm 软件支持。 据 TheStreet 报道，AMD 向全机架级人工智能系统的转变已经持续了一整年。
